analysis: Reviewed the head text of ClusterService.swift lines 488-1313 covering both units. The visible changes (changed ranges at 510, 646, 909, 1044, 1126, 1582) rewrite `Date() >= X` comparisons as `Date().timeIntervalSince(X) >= 0`. This is semantically equivalent for finite dates, with `.distantPast` yielding a very large positive interval. The changes cover the memory replan gate (line 510), the member sync gate (646), the stop-local-part deadline (909), the update check (1044) and the approval check (1126). I saw no change to authorization, pairing-pin checks, claim supersession (line 731), the control lock, token handling (soloAnswers sends the bearer token only to our own solo server), or the cache settings sync. The mutating command paths still require followsPeer(pairing), and the sync path still checks pairing.peerPin == leadership.peerPin. The change at line 1582 is outside the supplied excerpts; the patch excerpt is truncated, so I could not evaluate it. No new attack surface, regression, or invalidated assumption was identified for T-041, TB-011 or TB-012 in the visible code. Residual question: confirm that the unseen change at line 1582 is also a purely mechanical comparison rewrite.
